info.name: open-llm
info.description:
HTTP service for chatting with an open-source LLM on Groq (OpenAI-compatible).

Endpoints:
- GET  /          service info
- GET  /health    liveness probe
- POST /v1/chat        blocking chat completion (JSON)
- POST /v1/chat/stream streamed completion (chunked text)

Set the `baseUrl` variable (defaults to http://localhost:8080). The service reads its Groq API key server-side from the environment, so no auth header is needed from the client.

request.description: Returns service name, provider, model, and the list of endpoints.
Liveness probe. Returns {"status":"ok"}. Used by Render health checks.

Blocking chat completion. Returns a single JSON object with `content`, `model`, and `usage`.

Optional fields: `model` (override the server default), `temperature`, `max_tokens`.
Same endpoint, overriding the model per-request with the `model` field.
Streamed completion. The response is plain text (text/plain), sent as chunks as the model generates tokens. Postman shows the full body once the stream ends; use curl -N to watch tokens arrive live.
Demonstrates the 400 response: `messages` must not be empty. Returns {"error":"messages must not be empty"}.
